{{Top|ca|leg}}
A '''serraknife''' was a type of weapon used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="KE">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]],<ref name="Creating the Ships of Knight Errant">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html|text=Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''}}</ref> the weapon was considered ancient and exotic by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jarrow Rusher]], the [[Brigadier|leader]] of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] force [[Rusher's Brigade]]. Rusher, an amateur [[Historian/Legends|historian]] who enjoyed studying ancient warfare, named [[Serraknife Battalion|one]] of his [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] after the weapon.<ref name="KE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The serraknife was indirectly mentioned in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2011]] novel, [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']], which stated that all of the battalions of Rusher's Brigade, including Serraknife Battalion, were named after ancient weapons.<ref name="KE" /> Serraknife Battalion was the only battalion of Rusher's [[Brigade/Legends|Brigade]] whose namesake had not previously appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].<ref name="Name">Although the serraknife was not mentioned in any source before [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']], the other weapons have each appeared or been mentioned in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] at least once previously: [[Coyn'skar]] in "[[Out of the Cradle]]" ([[1994]]), [[dematoil]], [[rantok]], and [[sat'skar]] in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' ([[1995]]), [[Flechette/Legends|flechette]] in ''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'' ([[1997]]), [[Ripper (weapon)|ripper]] and [[Zhaboka/Legends|zhaboka]] in ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' ([[2008]]).</ref>
